title_cyr: Јас те пратив на вода Калино
title_latin: Jas te prativ na voda Kalino
title_en: I Sent You to the Water, Kalina
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Да мрси' is rendered 'to tousle', my reading of caressing the hair. Speaker changes between mother and daughter by stanza.

words_to_learn.en: may it be left desolate (a curse-like phrase)
